note: The day's picks card. Unlike the VS card this one has NO static template, because its height is not fixed: a slate carries five to seventeen rows and the canvas grows with them. So the artwork, when it arrives, cannot be one flat image either -- it has to arrive as three bands (header, one row, footer), which `bands` below names and the renderer composites. Until then the renderer draws the bands itself from `palette`. Every box is still read from this file rather than hard-coded, so a design revision stays a file swap.

bands.note: Filenames beside this one, when Kevin's artwork lands. A band is drawn at the canvas width and its own band height; the row band repeats once per row. A band left null is drawn from `palette` instead.

confidence_heading.note: Two stacked lines, and they sit BELOW the badge rather than beside it: the badge is square and as wide as this column, so the two would overlap. Kept clear of the rule below them as well.

logo_badge.note: Square, right edge on the content margin (x1360), matching the VS card's convention of standing the mark on the background rather than in a frame.

no_prediction.note: Spans both probabilities and the track. A row nobody can predict keeps its two names and says so across the middle.
